builder.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: transparent replacement resting-pose sprite for an existing website character animation.
Input image 1 is the sole identity reference and edit target: the grey stone-head, long green-arm, purple eye-covered sculptural character.
Primary request: show this exact same character AFTER it has finished pulling, physically TURNED from its left-facing pulling view toward the viewer into a front/three-quarter standing view. This must be a genuinely different body pose and camera-facing orientation, not the old pulling image rotated on the page or horizontally mirrored.
Keep all identity details and tactile materials: elongated grey carved stone human head, long textured green arm with green human fingers, turquoise loops, glossy purple torso covered in eyes, yellow accent, red/orange curved side, lime hip, lavender legs, orange human feet. Preserve proportions and sculptural collage style. No redesign, new clothes or extra limbs.
Pose: torso upright and turned toward us, head looking toward the viewer with a slight turn to the right. Long green arm relaxed down near the body, hands released, no reaching or pulling. Knees much straighter, two feet visibly planted and separated, a quiet resting stance. Keep the entire character including fingers and toes visible. Preserve overall height similar to the reference. Landscape canvas close to the reference aspect ratio with transparent padding, foot soles on one horizontal line around 96% canvas height. Feet must be separated, not crossed.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha everywhere outside the solid character, including every gap between limbs. Crisp clean antialiased cutout edges.
Constraints: exactly ONE character. No letter, typography, rope, props, pedestal, floor, ground shadow, haze, fog, glow or background color.
